host.policy: Workstation default; no affinity/frequency/background isolation; fixed4 Go Ps is not a native CPU quota

preflight.referenceHarnessDifference: Frozen reference predates owned buffered-mode flags/report metadata and cold options validation. Actual shared warm driver, complete response checker, HTTP/native kernels and reference-specific code remain identical; full harness files are identical between source base/head.
preflight.scope: One fixed20-block affected source event, both Rust fixtures and bounded buffered response API. Complete final-head dual-compiler/platform CI remains required. The oversized-spill microvariant is separate, with no macro prefix or pooled timing. Workstation background applications remain uncontrolled; no controlled release acceptance claim. One mistaken nested-test cwd ran duplicate root packages and was stopped after the first complete32-package root pass; its partial log is retained as llgo-wrong-cwd-diagnostic.log. Correct nested tests are checked separately.

macro.scope: Advisory fixed20-block affected P3 portfolio, all adverse observations retained. Independent inline structural-comparison event; both sources use the bounded buffered response API and the same worker/read-ahead implementation. No source sweep or reused timed prefix. No pooling with earlier immutable-copy events. Default host policy, not controlled release acceptance. Go managed/LLGo collector bytes differ, and Go counters exclude Rust/JIT allocation. Native-Go is an ordinary application control, not an optimized native lower bound.
